title: RNA Extraction Protocol for Shorea
author: mpfsum
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2ipqcdn
materials: Purification is done using RNeasy Plant Mini Kit Qiagen Catalog #74904 with minor adjustment to the protocol. Add 350 µL RLT buffer. Mix gently (flicking).
Evaluate the RNA quality using Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Weigh the sample and transfer it into a 1.5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 40 mg (range 25-40 mg) for BUD or 60 mg (range 50-70 mg) for LEAF.

steps.title: Tissue Grinding and Incubation
steps.instruction: Grind the sample in CTAB buffer using a tissuelyzer and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Use CTAB buffer consisting of 3% CTAB, 1.4 M NaCl, 20 mM EDTA, 100 mM Tris–HCl pH 8.0, and 0.2% b-mercaptoethanol.
Incubate the mixture at 60 °C for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from the lysate using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform.
Mix by vortexing (not too vigorously) to ensure the two phases are well homogenized.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm at room temperature for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 2/3 volume of isopropanol.
Mix gently by turning the tubes upside down for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Carefully discard the solution, leaving the white to translucent pellet.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL ethanol and mix gently by flicking the tube until the pellet no longer sticks to the tube.
Centrifuge at 5000 rpm at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Carefully discard the solution.

steps.title: Pellet Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend it in RNAse-free water.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet for 1 minute (repeat washing if necessary).
Resuspend the pellet in 50 µL RNAse-free water by flicking the tube until the pellet is no longer visible.
If the pellet is difficult to dissolve, wait ~30 min before flicking again; if it still does not dissolve, add more RNAse-free water and adjust subsequent steps accordingly.

steps.title: gDNA Removal
steps.instruction: Remove genomic DNA using the Turbo DNA-free Kit (Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM1907) following the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Column Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to an RNeasy Mini Spin column.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL absolute ethanol to the sample and mix gently by flicking.
Transfer the solution into an RNeasy Mini Spin column.
Centrifuge at 10000 rpm at room temperature for 15 seconds and discard the flow through.

steps.title: Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the column membrane with RW1 and RPE buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL RW1 buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10000 rpm at room temperature for 15 seconds, and discard the flow through.
Add 500 µL RPE buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10000 rpm at room temperature for 15 seconds, and discard the flow through.
Add another 500 µL RPE buffer to the column, centrifuge at 10000 rpm at room temperature for 2 minutes, and discard the flow through.
Replace the collection tube.
Centrifuge at 14000 rpm at room temperature for 1 minute.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA and store it at low temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Replace the collection tube with a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 50 µL RNAse-free water directly onto the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 10000 rpm at room temperature for 1 minute.
Store the extracted RNA at -20 °C or -80 °C for longer storage.
